profiles.description: Kyle Frankovich is a Harvard University data scientist who was arrested at the Broadview immigration detention facility protest on October 3, 2025. He said he had been observing and filming federal agents from a designated protest area. He was detained and released without charges. Images of him in restraints later appeared in federal recruitment material. In October 2026, he and Maureen Foody sued podcaster Benny Johnson for defamation, alleging that his videos falsely portrayed them as violent attackers.
profiles.name: Kyle Frankovich

profiles.description: Maureen Foody is an Illinois court reporter who was detained during a protest outside the Broadview immigration detention facility in October 2025 and released without charges. In October 2026, she and Kyle Frankovich filed a defamation lawsuit against podcaster Benny Johnson. They alleged that his videos falsely accused them of attacking federal officers and that the accusations exposed them to threats and professional harm.
profiles.name: Maureen Foody
